brief_rationale: The doctor systematically reproduced the care timeline from fragmented family text and workspace records (HO1), respected the patient’s privacy barrier while obtaining critical medication/symptom data via a practical, low-intrusion approach (HO2), and explicitly reprioritised the plan when the family later disclosed EF≈45% and uncertain medication execution (HO4). All authored responsibility-chain items were met without material error, and no important non-chain defect blocks Strong. Because three case-defined high-order points were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact, the trajectory satisfies the strict Perfect boundary.
